summary: Practise remote team goal-setting, handoffs and coaching with practical frameworks. Explore the five-day course and its learning outcomes.
lede: Leading remote teams training helps team leads, supervisors and project coordinators coordinate work across locations, schedules and time zones. It covers clarifying roles and handoffs with GRPI, SMART goals and RACI, keeping asynchronous decision logs, and using GROW coaching, SBI feedback and workload reviews to support follow-through and spot delivery risks.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who coordinate work across locations, time zones or remote schedules and need practical routines for accountability and support.
modules: Remote Leadership Review and Action Plan
prerequisites: Experience working in or coordinating a team is useful. Familiarity with routine digital collaboration is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
